mapper.select: SELECT principle_set_id, user_id, analysis_run_id, version_no, set_status, created_at, updated_at FROM principle_sets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND set_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE principle_sets SET set_status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND set_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO principle_sets (user_id, analysis_run_id, version_no, set_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{analysisRunId}, #{versionNo}, #{setStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
